WITH s AS (
 SELECT receipt_id, min(sale_date) sd, min(cast(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE)) ld, min(sale_ts_utc) ts, min(channel_id) ch
 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-30' AND '2025-12-02' GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT web_order_id, status, order_ts_utc, cast(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE) old, cast(order_ts_utc AS DATE) oud FROM fact_web_order)
SELECT s.sd, s.ld, o.old, o.oud, o.status, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.ts=o.order_ts_utc) same_ts
FROM s FULL JOIN o ON o.web_order_id=s.receipt_id
WHERE s.sd BETWEEN '2025-11-30' AND '2025-12-02' OR o.old BETWEEN '2025-11-30' AND '2025-12-02'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

WITH s AS (
 SELECT receipt_id, min(sale_date) sd, min(cast(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE)) ld, min(sale_ts_utc) ts, min(channel_id) ch
 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-30' AND '2025-12-02' GROUP BY 1),
o AS (SELECT web_order_id, status, order_ts_utc, cast(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE) AS ordl, cast(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS ordu FROM fact_web_order)
SELECT s.sd, s.ld, o.ordl, o.ordu, o.status, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.ts=o.order_ts_utc) same_ts
FROM s FULL JOIN o ON o.web_order_id=s.receipt_id
WHERE s.sd BETWEEN '2025-11-30' AND '2025-12-02' OR o.ordl BETWEEN '2025-11-30' AND '2025-12-02'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

WITH o AS (SELECT * FROM fact_web_order WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND cast(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE)='2025-12-01'),
l AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) lc, sum(gross_amount) g, bool_or(staff_purchase_flag) staff, min(quantity) minq FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date='2025-12-01' AND channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) orders, count(l.receipt_id) with_lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.line_count<>l.lc) lc_mismatch, count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(o.order_total_gross-l.g)>0.01) tot_mismatch,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.staff) staff, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.minq<=0) nonpos,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_key, order_ts_utc, order_total_gross FROM o GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_groups,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment_type='click_and_collect') cc, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment_type='home_delivery') hd
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
